no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (voice-edit) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Find the word changes a person keeps making to drafts written for them", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:find-repeated-voice-edits and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Counts, over the person's kept edits (kind narrows them), the words removed, added or replaced, each once per draft, and returns the changes found in at least min_distinct_drafts different drafts (3 when left out, never below 2), each with an example edit_id.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: voice-edit (records:read, records:list).
